# Final verification explanation

## Change and rationale

Verdict: branch-ready. Outcome: workflow-final-verification, governed-final, for 2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation. All five implementation milestones and their required corrections are complete; fresh independent final whole-change Code Review is approved. This distinct Verify establishes coordinated Release adoption for this repository's selected scope.

Release now owns the standing contract, with one front summary graph and an explicit routine operator path: CLI/CI prepares and checks a candidate, the maintainer approves that candidate once, and the protected executor publishes, observes and durably reports it. Existing reviewed version intent and established configuration supply decisions; missing or ambiguous input remains an exception. A separate model is appropriate for publication authority, irreversible public state and version-scoped evidence, while Distribution, Installation and general validation keep their owners.

Preparation seals reviewed source S and an allowlisted generated child C, builds adapter archives, derives actual bundled metadata/index, packs npm, executes the existing full verifier and binds the retained artifacts in outer evidence. Provider ZIP digest and member identities bind approval to those bytes. The executor uses current provider authority and public-state observations, publishes the retained tarball without repacking or token fallback, preserves uncertainty and failures, and maintains separate Git evidence through compare-and-swap. Restored attempts retain the original candidate and failed observations; confirmed operations are not repeated. Optional exact evidence mirroring and duration telemetry report their own limitations without replacing required publication facts.

The main-branch workflow has read-only preparation and one protected environment executor; the former unguarded tag publisher is removed. Actual CLI tests exercise normal completion, changed or missing authority, lost responses, failed installed smoke, failed reporting and restored recovery. Existing runtime safeguards and supported historical helper behavior remain. Necessary profile/evidence generation is automatic, and auxiliary timing loss no longer blocks an otherwise correct routine operation.

The six mapped Release spec/test-spec/ADR originals and only their mapped mixed-architecture prose are removed. Release contains their surviving requirements, applicability, operational formats, decisions and representative acceptance meaning. No archive, redirect, whole-directory deletion, operational record removal or blanket test deletion is inferred. The live literal-audit baseline and historical activation inventory remain byte-identical; retained adapter/publication histories and diagrams remain readable. FU-013 leaves Distribution/Installation with the repository maintainer and Route for the next bounded proposal; the Release portion is delivered by this change. Model/navigation adoption refers to this successful Verify rather than treating milestone approval as completion.

## Exact basis and evidence

```yaml
verification_basis:
  repository_identity: github.com/xiongxianfei/rigorloop
  remote_identity: https://github.com/xiongxianfei/rigorloop
  base_branch: main
  base_revision: eab1f8041f076312737ac1466a78c9a8de639445
  merge_base_revision: eab1f8041f076312737ac1466a78c9a8de639445
  head_branch: proposal/release-model-source-consolidation
  verified_subject_revision: 6510de02beedd35cfe225c62899bdb91eb6ee301
```

The final engineering basis is 6510de02. The cumulative subsequent handoff changes contain only attributable M5 implementation evidence, independent review, routing and distinct Verify records. No production, test, configuration, package, Design, plan or public-documentation bytes may change after that verified subject without reassessment. Original outcomes and failed evidence remain readable with their original meaning; evidence recording is not itself proof of engineering correctness.

Current direction is Proposal Review r7. Design Review r6 approves Release, scoped System, Design DES-SR-21 and the published-skill-first R7/R8 amendment. Delivery Review r3 approves the primary plan including M5/TG-09. Final Code Review code-review-final-r2 freshly assesses the whole delivered diff and cross-milestone interactions after M1–M5; prior milestone approvals do not substitute. All fourteen recorded findings are resolved by their original reporters, with no open blocker. Proposal r5's source-reliance gap is corrected by r6, which expressly ceases current reliance on all six removed originals; the old judgment and the earlier M4 author overstatement remain unchanged historical evidence.

| Obligation | Final implementation and proof |
| --- | --- |
| REL-SR-01–09; R7/R8 | M1 candidate/profile/preflight and actual full release verifier; final release regression checks the archive → bundled metadata/index → packed/installed CLI chain and negative input/evidence conditions. |
| REL-SR-10–19/23–24 | M2/M3 exact provider artifact and approval binding, OIDC retained-byte publication, actual observations, CAS persistence, uncertain/partial outcomes, recovery and diagnostic privacy/timing; actual executor and CLI scenarios in final release regression. |
| REL-SR-22–24; TG-FINAL-01 | M3 complete real CLI path, one substituted approval and external-service fixtures, immutable restoration, no repeated confirmed write, durable ref reader and optional exact mirror; parsed real YAML and selector/CLI checks. |
| REL-SR-20–21; DES-SR-13/18/19/21 | M4 exact six-source removal, preserved operational/history bytes, current owner/reference checks and original-assessor reliance disposition; deletion-aware final lifecycle proof plus independent semantic review. |
| SYS-SR-02/04/06/07/08/09 | Current composition, separate owners and immutable-input/observed-output relationship, bounded retained history and FU-013 remainder; model checks and fresh integrated review. |

Actual final execution: `bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base eab1f8041f076312737ac1466a78c9a8de639445 --head 6510de02beedd35cfe225c62899bdb91eb6ee301` passed exit 0. All 15 selected checks ran: record_store.schema, model.validate, boundary_first.validate, boundary_first.regression, skills.regression, adapters.regression, adapters.drift, adapters.validate, artifact_lifecycle.validate, change_metadata.regression, change_metadata.validate, release_transaction.regression, guide_system.validate, selector.regression and rigorloop_cli.test. The release regression includes real candidate construction, the full existing verifier and real package/installed CLI checks; public providers and Git evidence destinations are safe substitutes. Selected broad_smoke.required was false with no sources. No cache hit or configured command was represented as an actual pass. Current final-range results are durable in release-m5-implementation-r1.

Current model/boundary and prose checks passed. Current Release/plan/operator-guide readability passed with 168 advisories (166 MDREAD002 and two MDREAD003). Exact removal/current-link and retained-paragraph/baseline checks passed. The literal baseline remains SHA256 9859cd5ef43ff2cb1216a03e53b2ef5d45919cca3bf5868dc6d81d87682b43a1. Initial M4 explicit-path CI rejected absent original files; the existing PR-revision mode then passed actual deletion-aware lifecycle validation. That initial failure was not waived or relabeled.

M5 removed only scripts/validate-release-ci.py, its exclusive alias-delegation test, and reconciled its command disposition. Canonical validate-release.py --recorded-source-auto and recorded-commit/negative protection remain. The selector intentionally retains deleted-path classification. prepare-release.py, release-preflight.py and close-release-publication.py retain separately supported local/diagnostic/public-evidence uses; release_transaction.py and release-verify.sh remain actual coordinator dependencies. New helper count alone does not establish redundancy.

Original PR hosted run 34415416771/job102679093242 failed at old head6ef038a9 because the genuine integration fixture attempted git branch -M main on detached HEAD. M5 reproduced the failure by forcing detached checkout (15 tests, one error; exit128 at rename), then used git checkout -B main inside the temporary fixture. No production branch logic, workflow permissions or validator was weakened. The fresh final15-check run passed the real full path after the inventory changed. Both canonical recorded-source tests also passed independently. Failed hosted evidence remains release-pr-ci-detached-fixture-failure; replacement hosted CI is pending the updated push, not claimed passed here.

Final Verify checks current authority identities, completed work, all resolved findings, cumulative evidence-only suffix, clean tracked engineering, remote base, node scripts/validate-record-store.mjs docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/change.json and git diff --check.

Older M1/M2 runtime snapshots alone are not final proof: M3 changed their composition and tool inputs. Fresh final-range execution rebuilds from the current engineering and establishes applicability after source retirement. Old candidate receipts are not reused across script-inventory changes; the fresh M5 proof rebuilt the candidate. No required check is rerun merely because current review/Verify evidence was appended. Current checked-in archive/package metadata is unaffected: no authored skill, resource, adapter template, manifest or package payload changed; actual temporary candidates regenerate archive-derived projections through their owning builders. No stale hash or invented publication claim is used.

Impact classification: release runtime, public-operation authority, separate-ref persistence/recovery, build coordination, check selection/composition, documentation and source-retention governance are affected and covered above. Installer behavior, public skill content, package API/schema and historical state migration are unaffected by inspected source/payload and retained-byte differences. No external environment configuration changed. The change does not authorize other model transfers or general validation-policy retirement.

## Limitations and residual risks

Local validation and substituted complete-path tests do not prove hosted CI, configured remote environment/reviewer protection, npm trusted-publisher setup or a successful real release. One-time setup in docs/releases/README.md remains separately authorized; the operation rejects missing prerequisites. Real GitHub/npm publication, tag push, customer installation and remote configuration were not performed. The initial hosted failure is observed and preserved; the corrected replacement run is unobserved at this pre-push verification basis.

Irreversible publication and reporting remain the main operational risks. On conflict, uncertainty or incomplete reporting, preserve retained candidate/observations and inspect public/evidence state; do not blindly republish, overwrite a version or erase earlier failure. Engineering rollback restores the coordinated helper/workflow/owner slice and preserves operational inputs; it does not undo a public version. Recovery that changes version, channel, credentials or another material decision needs its proper authority. No runtime/token savings or deployment success is claimed.

This successful Verify supplies the final explanation, scoped adoption and branch-readiness basis. The user has separately requested PR submission, which Route may hand to the pr skill for identity-safe update of existing PR #181. Verify grants no merge or publication authority.
